g.text: SUPREME COURT OF THE UNITED STATES
Distribution of Supreme Court Citation Ages
October Terms 2004 and 2024 · Percentage of observed citation links within each term
Solid line: median · Dashed line: mean · Bins: 0–9, 10–19, … years; shared axes
Exploratory subsets. Extraction methods differ; unresolved citations are omitted. No inference of a historical trend.
